questions.question:
Which number will replace the question mark (?) in the following series?

6, 12, 20, 30, ?, 56
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is: 

**The series is as follows:,**

6, 12, 20, 30, ?, 56

lets see the applied logic:

12 - 6 = 6

20 - 12 = 8

30 - 20 =10

if u see clearly the difference between two numbers increases by two in the next term.

**Thus,**

**? - 30 = 12 (**? = 42)

56 - 42 = 14

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3c39dfdf66174c78c999fbf85010f8db965092dd2b567e173b7a80192606019b.png] 

**Hence, 42 is the correct answer.**
